sections.text:
[Effects]
The following will activate if your Class is Cleric/Berserker:
Increases magic Ability Power by XL.
The lower the current HP is when attacking, the greater the increase of magic Ability Power up to a max of 4XL.

[Activation]
When a magic attack Ability is used.
Only activates when playing as Cleric/Berserker.

[Activation Rate]
M
